cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Concede the Point
cards.instruction: Get them to release one claim, advantage, or disputed victory without reopening the entire contest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: In the holiday caption, admit I found the restaurant. You can keep credit for the whole trip.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You also complained about the menu.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: True. Leave that in. Just name me as the one who found it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll add that under the restaurant photo and leave your itinerary paragraph alone.

reason: A concedes the menu complaint, obtains B bounded credit and uses the agreement to make only the promised caption edit, without another obstacle.
